aca_welcome_desc: Susedko is a platform that lets you offer your services to customers in your area. Create a profile, set your availability calendar and start accepting orders — all through the app.
aca_verification_desc: After registration, your profile goes through an approval process. Customers will only see you after successful verification. The process has three steps:
aca_verification_email: A contract will be sent to your registration email for signing. It is important to sign it as soon as possible so you can start accepting jobs.
aca_verification_contract: After signing the contract, our team will review your profile and professions.
aca_verification_admin: Once approved by an administrator, your profile will be visible to customers and you can start earning.
aca_howto_profile_desc: Add a photo, bio, hourly rate and professions. A quality profile attracts more customers.
aca_howto_calendar_desc: Mark the days and hours when you are available. Customers can only book a slot during times you have marked as free.
aca_howto_requests_desc: Customers can send you a direct request. You accept or decline it and arrange details via chat.
aca_howto_broadcast_desc: Customers can post a request visible to all craftsmen in your category. Express interest and the customer may choose you.
aca_howto_payment_desc: You log the hours worked, the customer approves them and payment is processed directly in the app. No cash, no waiting.
aca_calendar_desc: The calendar is the heart of your work on Susedko. Customers can book you ONLY during times you mark as available. The more accurate your calendar, the more jobs you get.
aca_calendar_tip1: Update your calendar regularly — ideally every week.
aca_calendar_tip2: If you are not available, unmark those slots — avoid conflicts.
aca_calendar_tip3: Confirmed bookings cannot be removed from the calendar.
aca_payment_step1: After finishing the job, you log the actual hours worked.
aca_payment_step2: The customer receives a notification and can approve the hours or request an adjustment.
aca_payment_step3: After approval, the customer pays directly through the app.
aca_payment_step4: The payment will be transferred to the bank account listed in your profile.
aca_payment_note: Payment is secured via Stripe. You receive exactly what the customer approved.
aca_ratings_desc: After every completed job, the customer can rate your work. Ratings are visible to all customers and directly affect how many jobs you receive.
aca_ratings_tip1: More positive ratings = more customers and higher income.
aca_ratings_tip2: Be punctual, communicative and deliver quality work — good ratings will follow.

openRequests_no_professions_desc: Add professions to your profile to see relevant jobs.
